ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the base is a horizontal straight line, and points S, R, Q, P, M are successively on this baseline; above is a slanted line from H through J, K, L to M, so H, J, K, L, M are collinear. The pink arrows in the figure mark several slanted lines as parallel to each other, especially segment PL from P to L is parallel to segment QK from Q to K. Then reason: consider triangles MPL and MQK. They share the angle at vertex M, and PL ∥ QK, so triangle MPL and triangle MQK are similar. It is known that MP = 3, PQ = 6, LP = 2. Because Q, P, M are on the same straight line and Q is farther from M than P, QM = QP + PM = 6 + 3 = 9. By corresponding sides of similar triangles being proportional, QK/LP = QM/PM = 9/3 = 3. Therefore QK = 3 × 2 = 6.

raw_record.question_text: If $LK=4, MP=3, PQ=6, KJ=2, RS=6$, and $LP=2$, find $QK$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: P, Q, R, S, M lie on the same bottom line, and L, K, J, H, M lie on the same slanted top line. The marked arrows show PL is parallel to QK. Therefore triangles MPL and MQK share angle M and have a pair of corresponding parallel sides, so they are similar. From the text, MP = 3, PQ = 6, and LP = 2. Since Q is farther from M than P on the same base line, QM = QP + PM = 6 + 3 = 9. By similarity, QK/LP = QM/PM = 9/3 = 3, so QK = 3 · 2 = 6.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中底边是一条水平直线，点 S、R、Q、P、M 依次在这条底线上；上方是一条从 H 经过 J、K、L 到 M 的斜线，所以 H、J、K、L、M 共线。图中粉色箭头标出若干斜线互相平行，特别是从 P 到 L 的线段 PL 与从 Q 到 K 的线段 QK 平行。再推理：考虑三角形 MPL 和 MQK。它们共用顶点 M 处的角，并且 PL ∥ QK，所以三角形 MPL 与三角形 MQK 相似。已知 MP = 3，PQ = 6，LP = 2。因为 Q、P、M 在同一直线上且 Q 比 P 离 M 更远，所以 QM = QP + PM = 6 + 3 = 9。由相似三角形对应边成比例，QK/LP = QM/PM = 9/3 = 3。因此 QK = 3 × 2 = 6。

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a bundle of parallel cross-segments between two rays meeting at M: PL and QK are parallel, with P and Q on the bottom ray and L and K on the upper ray. Use an affine/linear-scaling setup: along the bottom ray, the length of the parallel cross-segment from the bottom ray to the upper ray is proportional to the distance from M. From the text, the cross-segment at P has length LP = 2 when MP = 3. The point Q is at distance MQ = MP + PQ = 3 + 6 = 9 from M. Since 9 is three times 3, the corresponding parallel segment at Q is three times as long as LP, giving QK = 3 · 2 = 6.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有两条从右端点 M 发出的射线：一条水平向左经过 P、Q、R、S，另一条斜向左上经过 L、K、J、H。图中从底边到斜边画了若干条同方向的线段，包括 PL、QK、RJ、SH，粉色箭头标明这些线段彼此平行。要求的是从 Q 到 K 的平行截线长度 QK。

推理：按照图中的平行截线关系，PL 和 QK 是同一组平行线段，且 P、Q 分别在从 M 出发的底边射线上，L、K 分别在从 M 出发的斜边射线上。因此，从底边到斜边的这类平行截线长度与其在底边上距 M 的距离成正比。已知 MP = 3，且 LP = 2。又因为 PQ = 6，所以 MQ = MP + PQ = 3 + 6 = 9。于是 Q 点到 M 的距离是 P 点到 M 的距离的 9/3 = 3 倍，所以对应的平行截线 QK = 3 × LP = 3 × 2 = 6。
